propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been a project manager in a mid-sized bank's regulatory reporting change team for four years, running six projects under the change framework with their plans, budgets and monthly steering committee reports, after two years as a project coordinator at an insurer.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the role, the years and the projects.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate completed the 35 contact hours, had the PMP application accepted in July 2026 and scheduled the exam for November 2026; managed the dependencies with the reporting platform and finance through the framework's dependency log; and wrote the six accepted closure reports with the boundary statements and deadline evidence.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the acceptance email document the exam status, the dependency work and the closure reports.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the PMP credential.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the acceptance email document an accepted application and an exam scheduled for November 2026; the credential itself appears only in the screen and the agency summary.

expectedGap: The materials document an accepted PMP application and an exam scheduled for November 2026; they do not document the credential being held.
expectedBoundaryNote: State the credential status as the resume gives it: application accepted, exam scheduled, not yet held.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the credential number and the institute's registry entry once the exam is passed.
